proposals.requirement: FR-060 (new); FR-003, FR-033, FR-056, FR-058, FR-059; edge-case; US1 scenario 5
proposals.rationale: reserve_memory applies bounded store backpressure (retry evict_and_insert on a 20ms poll until store_backpressure_ms budget, default 5000ms, then fail fast; budget=0 restores single-shot fail-fast) at src/lib.rs:3115. populate (src/lib.rs:2950) and batch_populate (src/lib.rs:3017) unconditionally best-effort drop on full: log, bump store_drops_on_full, return Ok(()) without caching, instead of propagating AllocationFailed (which the vLLM connector turns into a fatal assert transfer_result.success -> EngineDeadError). DispatcherConfig gained store_backpressure_ms; TierEventStats gained store_backpressure_events + store_drops_on_full (idispatcher.rs). Spec previously specified only FR-053 read-path staging and a four-field TierEventStats, and specified populate/batch_populate to surface AllocationFailed on a full tier.
proposals.accuracy_note: Drop-on-full is unconditional; store_backpressure_ms=0 disables ONLY the reserve_memory retry, not the caller-side drop. Verified against src/lib.rs:3150-3202. Spec text does not claim store_backpressure_ms=0 makes populate return AllocationFailed.
proposals.before: (store path) reserve_memory fails fast on AllocationFailed; populate/batch_populate surface AllocationFailed on a full tier; TierEventStats has four u64 fields (promotions_to_memory, promotions_to_gpu, evictions_from_memory, evictions_from_ssd).
proposals.after: New FR-060 (two-layer store backpressure: bounded backpressure in reserve_memory + unconditional best-effort drop-on-full in populate/batch_populate). FR-003/FR-033/FR-056/FR-058/FR-059 + one edge case + US1 acceptance scenario 5 updated; store_backpressure_ms config (default 5000) and store_backpressure_events/store_drops_on_full counters (six u64 fields) documented.

not_proposed: Two src/lib.rs 'gRPC handler' source comments: source out of editing scope; follow-up cleanup (carried over).
